autonomous_decisions.issue: PRD requires paths decoded with os.fsdecode, but the script uses strict `.decode()` on git output (`_text`, `_dirty` fields, worktrees, untracked) and `os.readlink(...).encode()` in `_fingerprint`. A non-UTF-8 file name in the target (valid on Linux) raises UnicodeDecodeError/UnicodeEncodeError. That is an uncaught traceback with exit 1, which the skill reads as "changed", not the "one stderr line, no traceback" contract. Use `os.fsdecode`/`os.fsencode` throughout (not run here: macOS rejects non-UTF-8 names, so this is from reading the code)

SKILL.md puts `compare ... start.json` and `snapshot ... lanes.json` in one bash block. The Bash tool reports only the last command's exit status, so the compare's exit 1 or 2 is masked by the snapshot's exit 0. The skill's own rule ("if it exits 1 or 2, dispatch nobody") then depends on the master reading stdout or stderr instead of an exit code. After a failed compare the snapshot still runs and writes `lanes.json`. Split into two separate bash calls, or say the compare's exit code must be captured before the snapshot runs. The text is PRD-verbatim, so this is a PRD defect carried into the skill

Fingerprinting follows symlinked parent directories outside the target. Replacing a tracked directory with an external symlink makes its deleted tracked children resolve outside the repository. Check ancestor components before opening files and reject external traversal; add this regression.
